From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@lexico.ai>
Date: 2027-03-25T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Demo + pricing — committed-use & startup discount

Thanks again for the time today — really enjoyed seeing Lexico's demo. Quick recap and next steps:

- Summary: you want low-latency generation for search re-ranking and summarization, roughly 10M–30M tokens/month to start, scaling to ~100M in 12 months
- Next actions: 1) send your expected monthly token volume ranges and target $/1M tokens, 2) confirm whether you can do a 12-month committed-use commit and an approximate $/month budget range, 3) we'll send a pricing estimate and show what we can do with committed-use + startup program stacked.

A couple notes on discounts:
- Redwood Startup Program: we have an early-stage credits/discount package for Series A startups (can provide up to 6 months of credits + 20–30% off for the first year depending on usage).
- Committed-use: typical blunt examples: 6–12 month commits can unlock 20–50% off hosted list depending on volume and multi-year incentives beyond that.

Can you confirm (reply all):
1) expected token volumes (low/normal/high per month),
2) budget range you expect to allocate to inference (monthly),
3) target effective $/1M tokens you need for unit economics.

I'll put together a short option table (no legal yet) once we have those numbers.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — great notes.

Quick answers:
- Volumes: initial run: 10M–30M tokens/month (Q2–Q3), plan to ramp to ~100M tokens/month within 9–12 months depending on product velocity
- Budget: we can allocate $40k–$100k/month for inference initially; larger budgets possible if unit economics work
- Target $/1M tokens: at scale we'd need ~<$1,000 per 1M tokens to meet our gross margin targets

We're a Series A (closed Feb 2027) — interested in the startup program details and whether the startup discount can be stacked with a committed-use discount. Procurement contact is procurement@lexico.ai; Tom Reyes (tom.reyes@lexico.ai) is on copy.

Attaching our product roadmap doc for reference (Lexico_Roadmap_Q2.pdf).

—Samir

Thanks Samir — this is super helpful.

A few quick calculations and an initial options table based on the ranges you gave:

- Baseline hosted (no commit): ~ $1,800 per 1M tokens (example list price for the model profile we demonstrated)
- Committed-use (12-month) examples:
  - $50k/month commit => effective ~$1,200 per 1M tokens at 20M tokens/month consumption (example)
  - $150k/month commit => effective ~$700 per 1M tokens at 100M tokens/month consumption
- Multi-year incentives / larger committed use can push effective pricing below your <$1,000/1M target — we can model a 12–24 month ladder to show the breakpoints.

Startup program stacking: yes, we can typically stack startup credits/intro discounts with committed-use pricing (subject to standard eligibility checks). For Series A customers we commonly offer credits + an additional 15–25% off the committed-use rates for the first year, subject to volume. I can confirm exact numbers with finance once you indicate a commitment tier.

Request: can you confirm which committed monthly spend bucket you'd be comfortable signing up for (e.g., $25k / $50k / $100k / $200k) and whether you need 12 vs 24 month terms? If you like, I can also draft a simple commercial term sheet and include DocuSign links for procurement and legal to review.

I'll attach the Redwood_Pricing_Tiers_v3.pdf (pricing sheet) and a one-pager showing example math for the buckets.

Best,
Marissa
